description: Figure 4 illustrates the relationship between the number of tokens used during training and the resulting Macro-F1 scores for two different approaches. The x-axis is labeled “Number of Tokens” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 9000, with tick labels at intervals of 1000. The y-axis is labeled “Macro-F1 Score” and has a linear scale ranging from 4.6 to 5.4, with tick labels at intervals of 0.2.  There are two lines displayed: a solid blue line representing “MATTER” and a dashed red line representing “w/o material knowledge”. The MATTER line begins at approximately 4.8 when the number of tokens is 0, increases to a value of 5.3 at 9000 tokens. The “w/o material knowledge” line starts at approximately 4.7 when the number of tokens is 0, and increases to a value of 5.1 at 9000 tokens.
